tree: the tree under measure (this repo by default)

contract.D1: the delivery fsyncs the PARENT DIRECTORY after the rename
contract.D2: that fsync happens AFTER the rename, not before
contract.D3: the temp file's own fsync is still there
contract.D4: a directory that cannot be fsynced does NOT fail the delivery

limits: the directory fsync makes the NAME durable against a crash of THIS machine
it does not protect against a filesystem that lies about fsync
it does not make the delivery atomic across a network filesystem
the check is at the moment of the delivery, not before the sign (TOCTOU window remains)
